summary.name: Raymarched Fractal Landscapes (Digital and 3D Aesthetics; extracted; synced 2026-10-12).
summary.visualIdentity: Reflective fractal solids emerge from dark fog, evolve into a landscape and return to sculptural lettering. Coherent reflections, spatial scale and depth define the look; flat imagery or SVG would fake them.
summary.suitableUses: Explicit: a 3-second preview where fractal solids emerge from fog with a slow dolly; the full concept adds landscape and sunset. Inferred: atmospheric 3D title or concept reveals. Interactive HTML use is unspecified.
summary.limitations: Reflections are single-bounce approximations, not path-traced, and the lower internal render resolution softens fine detail. Sculptural lettering is absent from the preview and is planned as a precomputed glyph-distance SDF, a limitation to report.
summary.palette: Background is scene-dependent: #080A0C is the specified fog colour and an authored fallback, not sampled source truth; the poster only confirms near-black surroundings. Foreground #F2EEE5 is a suggestion with 17.125:1 contrast on an opaque background. Gradients are disabled, and supplied exact colours override these tokens.
summary.motionAndInteraction: GSAP tweens uniforms on one paused timeline: uEmerge (fog density and fractal power), the camera path, and uLandscape (terrain blend). Each seek renders synchronously with no frame accumulation. Optional motion-043 orbit keeps the solid fixed; HTML interactivity is unspecified.
summary.audio: The source specifies no audio. The suggested direction is only a proposal, chosen from topic and audience, with no fixed genre, tempo or mandatory layer. No audio assets were supplied, and the 3-second preview may stay silent. Music synchronisation requires measured audio data.
summary.assetRequirements: Only one reference poster (xanares-738984) was supplied, and it does not verify the full video. Lettering needs a precomputed glyph distance texture and fonts, and neither is supplied. Motion-038 needs an actual punctuation mark or approved glyph. Copy is unspecified.
summary.combinations: Supporting style-099 adds a continuous camera path; keep style-120 dominant and do not import its palette. Avoid competing full-scene treatments or replacing the dark background with an accent or subject material. Motion-038 and motion-043 are optional and conditional on scene support.
summary.productionApproach: Style renderer: Three.js ShaderMaterial with GLSL raymarching, bounded iterations and steps, rendered offscreen at about 0.5–0.66 scale. Motion engine: GSAP paused timeline. Pipeline: HyperFrames by default; Remotion only with a recorded reason. chroma.js is optional for colour checks.
